Direct shear test on RC2 soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (Broadly graded)) at relative density 0; apparatus: direct shear (University of Notre Dame). Recorded: peak shear stress vs normal stress.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 22 of the 28 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. Student reviewers have looked at 14 of the 28 points on the scan; two reviewers confirmed 11 of them (see the provenance page). The test setup is incomplete: specimen height, normal stress, held constant, displacement rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![maximum shear stress against normal stress, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-ds-fc-4a-dr0.png){.lightbox}

Peak maximum shear stress 230.6 kPa at 239.6 kPa normal stress, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-4a-dr0/observations.csv) (28 points: 5 plotted symbols, 22 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: maximum shear stress in Pa against normal stress in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-4a-dr0/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 1.1 kPa in normal stress, 1.1 kPa in maximum shear stress (0.5 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 22 of the 28 points; the other 6 were settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fc-4a).
